description: List all commune-level units (phường, xã, đặc khu) of one province. scope "new" (default): communes after the reform with codes and any 2026 changes; scope "old": communes as of 30 June 2025 with their district. The province may be a 2-digit code or a name. Example: {"province":"79"}; {"province":"Đà Nẵng","scope":"old"}. Output can be long (up to a few hundred entries); prefer find_units for a single name.

province.description: Province: 2-digit code (e.g. "79") or name (e.g. "Hồ Chí Minh", "Ha Noi").

scope.description: "new" (default): communes after the reform. "old": communes as of 30 June 2025, with their district.

name: list_wards
title: List communes of a province
